headline: Sarvam names ex-Google Cloud India head Sashikumar Sreedharan President and CBO
quote: Today, over 100 enterprises and government institutions are building with Sarvam’s full-stack offering.
claim: Sarvam announced on 9 Nov 2026 that Sashikumar Sreedharan, most recently Managing Director for India at Google Cloud, joins as President, Chief Business Officer and board member. Sarvam says over 100 enterprises and government institutions are building with its full-stack offering.
why_it_matters: Sarvam is staffing up for enterprise and government sales, a sign of where Indian model-lab hiring and customer demand are heading.
title: Sashikumar Sreedharan joins Sarvam as President and CBO | Sarvam AI

headline: Sarvam adds watermark detection endpoint for Instant Voice Cloning
quote: Instant Voice Cloning (beta) now exposes POST /voices/watermark/detect.
claim: Sarvam's changelog for 9 Nov 2026 lists a beta endpoint POST /voices/watermark/detect that checks whether a clip carries the Sarvam STFT watermark; max 10 MB upload, rate limited to 5 requests per minute, consumes no credits.
why_it_matters: If you build with synthetic Indian-language voices, you can now programmatically check whether audio came from Sarvam's cloning, free of credits.
title: Change Log | Sarvam API Docs

headline: Sarvam Voice Agents adds campaign experiments with 90/10 traffic splits
quote: split calls across two to five committed versions of the same agent and choose each version’s share of traffic
claim: On 11 Nov 2026 Sarvam's changelog added Experiments (beta) for outbound Voice Agents campaigns, splitting calls across two to five committed versions of an agent with a chosen traffic share.
why_it_matters: Lets you A/B test voice-agent prompts on real calls before full rollout, useful if you prototype Indic voice bots.
title: Change Log | Sarvam API Docs
